items.q: Plants make food using ___.
items.explain: Plants use sunlight to make their food.

items.q: The green colour in leaves is ___.
items.explain: Chlorophyll makes leaves green and traps sunlight.

items.q: Plants take in which gas to make food?
items.explain: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.

items.q: Plants give out which gas?
items.explain: Plants give out oxygen that we breathe.

items.q: Leaves store food as ___.
items.explain: Plants store their food as starch.

items.q: Water reaches the leaves through the ___.
items.explain: The stem carries water up from the roots.

items.q: Tiny pores on leaves are ___.
items.explain: Stomata are tiny pores that let gases in and out.

items.q: Making food with sunlight is called ___.
items.explain: Photosynthesis means making food using light.

items.q: Which plant eats insects?
items.explain: A pitcher plant traps and eats insects.

items.q: Cuscuta takes food from other plants. It is a ___.
items.explain: A parasite lives on another plant for food.

items.q: Fungi like mushrooms get food from ___.
items.explain: Mushrooms feed on dead and rotting things.

items.q: Which part of the plant makes most food?
items.explain: Leaves are the plant's food factories.

items.q: Which one lets heat pass easily?
items.explain: Metals like iron let heat pass through quickly.

items.q: Which one is a poor conductor of heat?
items.explain: Wood does not let heat pass easily.

items.q: We measure temperature with a ___.
items.explain: A thermometer measures how hot or cold something is.

items.q: Normal body temperature is about ___.
items.explain: Our body is usually about 37 degrees Celsius.

items.q: Heat from the sun reaches us by ___.
items.explain: Sunlight's heat travels to us by radiation.

items.q: Warm air ___.
items.explain: Warm air is lighter, so it rises.

items.q: In summer, we wear ___ clothes.
items.explain: Light colours and thin cloth keep us cool.

items.q: Woollen clothes keep us warm by trapping ___.
items.explain: Wool traps air, which keeps the heat in.

items.q: A pan handle is made of plastic because plastic is a ___.
items.explain: Plastic stops the heat reaching our hand.

items.q: Heat moves from a ___ object to a cooler one.
items.explain: Heat always flows from hot to cold.

items.q: A sea breeze blows from sea to land in the ___.
items.explain: In the day, land heats faster, so air moves in.

items.q: Ice melts when we ___ it.
items.explain: Heating ice turns it into water.
